description: As a participant in the Merdeka Belajar Kampus Merdeka (MBKM) program at PT Racer Robot Indonesia, I was trusted to join the Trainer Division, where I played an active role in various aspects of learning and training activities. My main tasks include developing adaptive learning plans and compiling educational materials that are interactive, interesting, and easy to understand for students from various backgrounds. I was directly involved in the teaching and learning process, from planning to implementation, with a focus on improving the learning experience of participants through an applicable and enjoyable approach. In addition, I played an important role in training camp activities designed to prepare students for robotics competitions both at the national and international levels. As part of the HR development program, I was also involved in Training of Trainers (ToT) activities aimed at providing supplies and assistance to teachers and representatives of educational institutions, in order to increase the effectiveness of their assistance to students during the training process. Trust was also given to me to be one of the speakers in the Teaching Practitioner program at Handayani University Makassar, where I presented material entitled Physical Interaction and Game and Animation. This opportunity has become a valuable experience in applying my technical skills in a college-level academic environment. Outside of academic and training, I also actively contribute to supporting the promotion and marketing strategies of the company's robotic kit products, as well as taking part in the planning and implementation of various events organized by PT Racer Robot Indonesia.

As a student of the Merdeka Belajar Kampus Merdeka (MBKM) program, I got a valuable opportunity to join the Research and Development (R&D) Division at PT Racer Robot Indonesia. In this role, I am directly involved in the research and development process of various products in the field of robotics, ranging from basic to advanced levels. My main focus is designing and developing educational robot kits, which include various types of robots such as basic robots, line followers, maze solving robots, drones, to humanoid robots. Some of these development modules are the results of my own research which were then further developed with the team to become ready-to-use products in learning activities and robotics competitions. I also contributed to the process of compiling technical learning modules, which are designed to make it easier for students to understand the concept and implementation of robotics technology gradually and systematically. The projects I work on are not only technical in nature, but also emphasize team collaboration and integration between divisions in achieving product development targets. In addition to my technical role, I actively support the promotion and marketing activities of Robot Kit products to educational institutions and technology communities, as well as participating in various events organized by the company. This contribution broadens my understanding of technology-based product commercialization strategies. As one of my achievements, I successfully completed a team project that resulted in an innovative robotics module, designed to enrich participants' learning experience through a practical and applied approach in the field of robotics.
